title: Uncover Snow White's Secret Renaissance Dance: Galliard Tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor adopts a persona, teaching in character as the Evil Queen from Snow White with theatrical flair. She breaks down the galliard basic step into counts of four kicks and a stomp.

lesson_structure.note: Title and introduction to Snow White galliard
The Evil Queen introduces the galliard and court context
Explaining the galliard basic step of four kicks and a stomp
Demonstration of the galliard basic by costumed dancers

steps_taught.name: Galliard Basic
steps_taught.description: Four kicks followed by a stomp/step

what_works: clear counts and breakdown of kicks and stomp
what_hinders: costumes and character acting may overshadow strict instructional clarity

quotes.text: Welcome to the historically accurate cartoon princess dances.
We are going to learn the galliard.
We will do a galliard basic.
I have been grim-hilled your evil queen.

evidence_segments.observation: Dancers perform four kicks and a step facing forward in a wide stance.

extraction.distinctive_method: Teaching historical Renaissance dance through fairy tale character roleplay.
